name: Guo et al. 2003-2007, 3-phase SMC claw-pole motor, 500 W at 1800 rpm (Table V of the TFM paper)
source: Y. G. Guo, J. G. Zhu, P. A. Watterson, W. Wu, "Development of a permanent magnet claw pole motor with soft magnetic composite core", Australian J. Electrical & Electronics Eng. 2(1), 21-30, 2005 (main paper, open: https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/bitstream/10453/166879/3/). Also: Guo, Zhu, Lu, IEE Proc. EPA 153(4), 2006; Guo, Zhu, Wu, JSAEM 15, 2005 (2nd sub-airgap); Guo, Zhu, Wu, IEEE TMAG 41(6), 2005 (wire); Guo, Zhu, Zhong, Wu, IEEE TMAG 39(5), 2003 (SOMALOY 500 loss fit).

notes.stator: Two SOMALOY 500 discs per phase with 10 rectangular claws each, ring coil between them (stated). Stator outer radius 40, coil window 17 x 11 (17 axial: discs (31 - 17) / 2 = 7 = the stated narrowest disc section; then the claw overlap leaves the stated 1.65 mm magnet overhang), 1st sub-airgap 4.2 mm between neighbouring claws -> claw width 2 pi 40 / 20 - 4.2 = 8.4 mm = tooth_span 0.667, 2nd sub-airgap 2.65 mm claw tip to opposite disc = claw_tip_gap, shaft radius 9 -> claws 10 mm thick with a 10 mm yoke (40 - 11 - 10 - 10 = 9). Claw shape from the papers' figures (JAEEE 2005 Fig. 1, IEE Proc. 2006 Fig. 1, field region Fig. 2): each disc is a full disc with 10 rim teeth, one under each of its own L-shaped claws; at the claw level a disc has no iron where the claws of the other disc reach across (mesher option claw_full_discs).
notes.assumed: claw thickness 10 mm without taper (variant 7 mm), continuous discs and yoke (the per-frame claw-pole core of the Onshape feature does not mesh at these dimensions: 'segment and facet intersect'), coil 16 x 6 mm at the bottom of the window (gives the mean turn radius about 22 mm that the measured resistance implies), magnet remanence 1.10 T (N30M), SMC Froehlich mu_r 500 / Js 1.9 T, mild steel mu_r 2000 / Js 2.0 T, SMC density 7300 kg/m3.
notes.rotor: Outer rotor, magnets OD 88 x ID 82 x 15 mm axial, arc 12 deg, one row per phase centred on the claw overlap; rotor yoke 3 mm (OD 94). The rotor yoke is modelled over the magnet length (15 mm) only.
notes.not_modelled: coupling between the stacks, mild-steel shaft (0.007 mWb, negligible per the authors), six-step current (sinusoidal here with the same rms), rotational core loss (the authors' loss model includes it; here alternating loss on the peak flux density).
notes.history: First runs (kept under variants/): discs as full rings up to the air gap (discs_to_air_gap: inductance 11.2 mH) and O-frames with legs on both discs at every pole (frames_both_discs: 10.9 mH) put iron 2.65 mm from every claw tip and doubled the coil leakage; the papers' figures show the L-shaped claws used now.
notes.losses: T31: SOMALOY 500 alternating and rotational loss (Guo, Zhu, Zhong, Wu, IEEE TMAG 39(5), 2003); mild-steel rotor yoke conductivity 1.12e7 S/m (stated in the claw-pole papers), thin-plate eddy formula with the skin-effect factor of a plate at the incremental permeability of the B-H model (no fitted correction; the authors' factor k_e is not published); NdFeB conductivity 6.7e5 S/m (assumed).
